judged_text: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the zod SafeParseReturnType wrapper ({success, data}), and the Google refresh path persists that wrapper object directly as the credential key (`data: { key }`), replacing the previous `googleCredentialSchema.parse(...)` which returned the bare credentials. After the first token refresh, credential.key in the DB is `{success:true, data:{access_token,...}}` instead of the credentials object; every later GoogleCalendarService read (`credential.key as GoogleCredentials`) sees undefined access_token/refresh_token at the top level, so Google Calendar auth breaks for that user until manual repair.
